## When to use

Use this skill when the user asks about:
- Fetching, caching, syncing, and updating server state with React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, or Angular
- useQuery, useMutation, useInfiniteQuery, useQueries, useSuspenseQuery hooks
- QueryClient methods (invalidateQueries, prefetchQuery, setQueryData, etc.)
- Query keys, query functions, and query options patterns
- Optimistic updates, mutations, and cache invalidation
- SSR, hydration, dehydration, and streaming with TanStack Query
- Background refetching, stale time, gc time, network mode
- Persistence plugins (localStorage, AsyncStorage, broadcastQueryClient)
- ESLint plugin rules for TanStack Query
- TypeScript usage with TanStack Query
